but the two governments are alike destitute of good faith. The States extend what they
are pleased to term the benefits of their laws to the Indians, with a belief that the
tribes will recede rather than submit. And the central government, which promises a permanent
refuge to these unhappy beings, is well aware of its inability to secure it to them. Why?
